observations: MALAM SAMA OPAH (+18, 17 days), Paint and Hide! (+16), MOUSE (+15), Fake an Egg (+11) and Scary Baboon Reimagined (+11) rose most; four of the five are horror or escape titles.
The Hollow, the Roblox-run event game, fell 54 places at 24 days, and Say Cheese! [STORY] (-16), Practical Basketball (-11), Climb The Rake Tower (-10) and Cat Battles (-10) also fell.

Six games entered, among them Realistic Ragdoll Playground (20 days), Make a Cartoon!, Cook the Chicken (by slapping it), Sell a Million Sushi (99% likes) and the 357-day-old 100 Days at Sea; four left, including Dreamville RP, 1M Clicks To Escape and Ragdoll Physics 2.
Steal An Egg (104 days), Brookhaven, DONT SPLASH (20 days), RIVALS, Murder Mystery 2 and 99 Nights in the Forest still lead on the cumulative pillar.

By age the median pillar percentile runs from the 38th at 15-42 days to the 66th at 4-12 months, so the mid-life trough (H-mp-009 at 48%) again does not show, though only 12 games sit between 85 days and a year.
patterns: Updates still tend to go with staying power: games left more than 27 days without an update stay fewer days (r=-0.67) and weekly updaters stay longer (H-mp-018 at 65%), but recent updates now only tend to go with higher positions (H-mp-006 fell from 78% to 57%).

Higher prices consistently go with dominance: a median pass above 149 R$ holds at 74% (H-mp-001), and median products above 400 R$ (r=+0.42) and median passes above 79 R$ (r=+0.41) split days on the chart.

Original concepts tend to hold higher positions (H-mp-013, down from 78% to 65%), studio-scale complexity tends to go with more days (H-mp-015 at 65%), and verified creators stay longer (r=+0.26), though creator size is partly a result of success.

Among profiled loops, '+1' incrementals (84th median percentile, 4 games) and steal-defend bases (76th, 7 games) sit high while co-op wave survival (11th) and obby platformers (36th) sit low; small groups make these speculative.
Big evergreens consistently convert fewer visits into favorites (H-mp-010 at 83%, r=-0.41); this is a lifecycle effect, not a lever.

outliers.name: The Hollow
outliers.note: Fell 54 places at 24 days with no passes or products; as a Roblox-run event game its lift likely ends with the event window (H-x-020 lowered to 38%).

outliers.name: Steal An Egg
outliers.note: Still tops the pillar at 104 days while its clones fade elsewhere, which alone makes 'Egg' the strongest positive title keyword (r=+0.47).

outliers.name: 100 Days at Sea
outliers.note: Entered at 357 days with a 97% like ratio but sits weakest on the pillar with no game passes, a sign that strong reception alone does not buy position.

observations: Donation hubs again lead efficiency (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS), with New Journey (946 days), Clover RPG and Build and Burn close behind.
Flee the Facility, Throw Food For Animals, Deagle Arena and Ragdoll Sandbox remain the least efficient: large free audiences with few products.

Anime vs Anime! (+85, 40 days, an RNG roll loop with 171 products), Ragdoll Sandbox (+79), Shibuya [Beta] (+71), Final Stand: Remastered (+58) and Pocket Landlord (+50, 17 days) rose most; Pixel Lineage (-43), Own a Catboy Café (-40), Anime Zero (-38), Candy Kingdom Defense (-34) and Escooter Life (-34) fell most.

Eight games entered, among them Karinderya! (236 products), Ride An Egg (298 products), Clover Legends and the 4,098-day-old Arsenal; nine left, including Halloween titles Pokemon Brick Bronze, Saber Simulator and HUNTRESS, plus Steal ASMR!.
Efficiency consistently rises with age, from the 23rd median percentile at 15-42 days to the 63rd past a year (H-te-001 at 84%); the 77 games updated in the last day moved a median -1.
patterns: High prices consistently pay: median products above 79 R$ split efficiency at r=+0.56 (H-te-005 at 91%), and a top pass above 699 R$ (r=+0.32) and median passes above 514 R$ (r=+0.33) also go with efficiency (H-te-006, H-te-025 at 91%).

Steal-and-defend-base loops (r=-0.73) and physics sandboxes (r=-0.64) are consistently the weakest earners per player (H-te-024 at 91%, H-te-045 at 88%), with 'Egg' (r=-0.76) and 'Steal' (r=-0.71) the worst title keywords.

RPGs (r=+0.44), PvP combat (r=+0.30), roleplay hubs (73rd percentile), tower defense (72nd) and story adventures (70th) consistently earn more per player, while solo loops (r=-0.33) and the Simulation genre (r=-0.29) earn less.
Complexity (rho=+0.28), servers split at 40 players (r=+0.32) and longer descriptions (r=+0.27) consistently go with efficiency; all three also track game age, the likely confounder.
A roll or luck layer tends to earn more per player (H-te-037 at 57%), and today's biggest riser, Anime vs Anime!, is a roll-and-collect game.

outliers.name: [RANKED!] Anime vs Anime!
outliers.note: Rose 85 places at 40 days despite the anime theme earning less on average (H-te-003 at 63%); its RNG roll loop and 171 products fit the luck-layer pattern instead.

outliers.name: [🎃] Ragdoll Sandbox
outliers.note: Rose 79 places yet stays among the least efficient earners with a single developer product; it climbs on audience volume, not spend per player.

outliers.name: Arsenal
outliers.note: Re-entered Top Earning at 4,098 days, updated today, another veteran PvP shooter fitting the combat-PvP efficiency pattern (H-te-022).

observations: +1 Boxing Battle Evolution (+34, 20 days), the Arabic horror game الشايب (+33, 21 days), Escape The Walls (+20) and Punch Out Of Prison (+17) climbed most; three of the four are escape or '+1' incrementals.
You and Me in Cali RP (-30), Realistic Ragdoll Playground (-26), Teach Your Granny How To Drive! (-22), 30 Floors Up (-21) and Create A Disaster (-19) fell most.

Twelve games entered, among them Ragdoll Physics, Ragdoll Wars!, Survive Your Ideas, Onthel Purwodadi, Become the Potato! (13 days) and 13 Days to Escape; eleven left, including My Small Business, +1 Upgrade Per Kill [🎃], Riot City and Flying Tesla Roadster.
The 16 games updated in the last day moved a median -4.5 against -1.0 for the rest, a second day against fresh updates (H-tt-005 at 72%).
Games of 43-84 days sit at the 66th median percentile against the 52nd for 15-42 days, so the six-week fade (H-tt-001) weakened to 44%.
patterns: A skill-based competitive core consistently goes with lower positions (r=-0.48, within-age -0.67; H-tt-054 at 75%), and PvP social play tends to as well (r=-0.38, within-age -0.47).

Selling currency packs goes with lower positions and slower climbs (r=-0.35 and -0.36), against H-tt-010 at 34%; cash-tycoon mechanics (r=-0.43) and descriptions that ask for likes (r=-0.34 on momentum) may also slow young games, both now tests.
Cheaper launch pricing may help: median products above 159 R$ split positions at r=-0.46, while having any game pass goes with higher positions (r=+0.42; H-tt-019 at 65%).
Verified creators consistently hold higher positions (r=+0.25, within-age +0.36; H-tt-057 at 77%), so creator scale remains a confounder for most young-game signals.

outliers.name: [FPS] Pixel Arena
outliers.note: Among the best on the pillar again at 35 days despite a competitive PvP shooter core (against H-tt-054); its pixel style and short rounds may lower the skill barrier.

outliers.name: Draw a Flag!
outliers.note: Among the best on momentum with a 57% like ratio, against the like-ratio pattern (H-tt-004 at 63%); a curiosity drawing hook carries it.

outliers.name: الشايب [رعب]
outliers.note: An Arabic folk-horror game that climbed 33 places at 21 days, proposed with MALAM SAMA OPAH as a regional-horror idea.

observations: Survive Your Ideas (31 days), Ragdoll Physics (+73), DONT SPLASH, MALAM SAMA OPAH, Onthel Purwodadi (+63) and Can You Pass A Driving Test? lead, a mix of horror, ragdoll physics and driving.

Cozy Lucky Scoop Order (+57), 13 Days to Escape (+54) and Low Range: Offroad 4x4 (+33) also rose sharply; Make Viral Candy! (-42), TROLL Jail Hug Tower (-39) and 30 Floors Up, Create A Disaster and Realistic Ragdoll Playground (-31 each) fell most.

Nineteen games entered, among them Ragdoll Wars!, WRECKED, Ragdoll Research (9 days), South Hell, +1 DONT SPLASH and Chop and Steal an Egg; nineteen left, including Ride An Egg, Style Outfit Tower!, Teach Your Granny How To Drive! and Rush To The Airport.
The 16 games updated in the last day moved a median -16 against -3.5 for the rest, contrary to H-uc-012 (79%), which measures update recency rather than one day's moves.
The newest games still rank highest: 0-14-day games sit at the 57th median percentile against the 48th for 15-42 days and the 38th for 43-84 days.
patterns: Update tags in the title now go with lower positions (r=-0.56, within-age -0.58), against H-uc-051 (30%) and in line with bracket tags in general (H-uc-004 at 51%).

Horror-escape loops (9 games at the 83rd median percentile, r=+0.46) and escape/flee mechanics (within-age +0.41) may rank higher, now a test, while PvP loops consistently rank lower (r=-0.52; H-uc-038 at 77%).

Storage or slot passes consistently go with higher positions (r=+0.38; H-uc-052 at 79%); a luck pass also does (r=+0.39) while RNG framing of the core loop goes lower (r=-0.34; H-uc-048 at 66%), so luck sold as a boost may work where luck as the premise does not.
Higher like ratios consistently go with higher positions (split at 75%, r=+0.36; H-uc-006 at 77%), and median products above 136 R$ may go lower (r=-0.39), now a test.
Driving games are recovering: Onthel Purwodadi, Low Range: Offroad 4x4 and Can You Pass A Driving Test? rose or lead, and racing_driving games sit at the 62nd median percentile (H-uc-043 at 36%).

outliers.name: Ragdoll Physics 🩸
outliers.note: Rose 73 places to #2 at 25 days with no developer products, the clearest sign that breakout does not need a store (and that physics sandboxes earn little per player).

outliers.name: Make Viral Candy! 🍬
outliers.note: Fell 42 places at 19 days while selling 17 passes and 102 products, consistent with heavy launch monetization going with lower breakout positions.

outliers.name: Survive Your Ideas
outliers.note: Took the top at 31 days with a 77% like ratio, older than most leaders; letting players' typed ideas become the content keeps it fresh.

summary: Halloween fallout continued: Pokemon Brick Bronze (Halloween), Saber Simulator and HUNTRESS left Top Earning and +1 Upgrade Per Kill [🎃] left Top Trending, while [🎃] Ragdoll Sandbox, updated today, rose 79 on Top Earning; H-x-027 rises from 40% to 45%.

Pricing splits the charts: median developer-product price goes with Most Popular (+0.28) and Top Earning (+0.38) but against Top Trending (-0.26) and Up-and-Coming (-0.22). Game age is the likely confounder; it is proposed as a qualitative 'launch cheap, raise later' idea at 35%.

Breakout and revenue still pull apart: physics sandboxes and steal-defend loops lead or enter Up-and-Coming (Ragdoll Physics, Ragdoll Wars!, Chop and Steal an Egg) but consistently earn least per player (r=-0.64 and -0.73); H-x-002 holds at 50%.

Competition splits the charts again: a skill-based competitive core goes against Top Trending (-0.48) and Up-and-Coming (-0.38) while PvP combat consistently earns more per player (+0.30, H-te-022 at 91%).
Regional folk horror (MALAM SAMA OPAH, الشايب) is proposed as a speculative idea at 25%, beside the sound-hunting horror wave (H-x-019 at 55%) led by DONT SPLASH.

Gameplay videos are still unlabelled for the sixth run: Dragon Adventures, Creatures of Sonaria, Sol's RNG and Basketball: Zero are frames_ready with 0 frames and no contact sheets. No new outside research was waiting. 60 games were profiled today.
progressions: uc→tt remains the most common transition (193 entries, up from 184, median 2 days), ahead of tt→mp (157, up from 155, median 2 days).
uc→te (121, 5 days), tt→te (114, 4 days) and uc→mp (103, up from 101, 4 days) keep showing breakouts reaching revenue and dominance within about a week, while tt→uc stays at 1.
Realistic Ragdoll Playground completed the uc→tt→mp path, entering Most Popular at 20 days, while Ragdoll Physics jumped 73 places on Up-and-Coming and entered Top Trending the same day.
